name: DS18B20 1-Wire digital thermometer
description: Maxim DS18B20 thermometer on a 1-Wire bus: a unique 64-bit ROM code found by the search algorithm, 9- to 12-bit conversions (93.75 to 750 ms), the scratchpad with its CRC, TH/TL alarms and the EEPROM, its own supply or parasite power from DQ. The temperature is an interactive input; DQ needs a pull-up (4.7 kOhm).

pins.name: DQ
pins.doc: 1-Wire data, open drain; needs a pull-up (4.7 kOhm)

pins.name: VDD
pins.doc: Supply, 3.0 to 5.5 V; grounded (or open) the part is parasite powered from DQ

serial.doc: The 48-bit serial number in the ROM code (each part's is unique)

inputs.name: temperature
inputs.doc: read from the world's temperature while not set

outputs.name: alarm
outputs.doc: The alarm flag ALARM SEARCH answers to

functional.claims: The 1-Wire slots at the datasheet's timing, with the presence (27 us after the reset, 120 us) and a read 0 (held 28 us) as two real parts did them in sigrok's capture of a bus (tests/captures/ds18b20, checked by tools/verify/replay_captures.py: their four ROM searches, 512 bits, match bit for bit, the ROM codes' CRCs among them) (write slots sampled at 30 us, read slots answered on the falling edge); the ROM code (family 0x28, 48-bit serial, CRC) with READ, MATCH, SKIP, SEARCH ROM and ALARM SEARCH; CONVERT T at the resolution's maximum time (93.75 to 750 ms) with read slots 0 until done on its own supply; the scratchpad (85 C at power-up, TH, TL, configuration, CRC) written, read, copied to and recalled from the EEPROM; READ POWER SUPPLY; parasite power with VDD grounded; no answer with VDD between 0.5 and 3.0 V.
omissions: the accuracy spread between parts (+-0.5 C from -10 to 85 C)
the package's thermal lag and self-heating
